m: {Lara Croft} vaults through a window into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} hut and prises a cursed relic off the sink. A stone *servant* clanks awake, kneels and carries her ponytail, her ropes and her boulder-dodging boots. The curse is simple: whoever touches the relic gets a **servant**, so he touches it too and acquires a tiny **servant** of his own.

{Lara Croft} rappels into the {Basement} of the {Museum}, where a puzzle tomb opens only if an ancient oath is kept. A carved *lying man* swore to guard this floor, so he rolls *back and forth*, crushing every trap she triggers while she somersaults over him. The door grinds open, his oath **fulfilled**, and Lara salutes a statue who can **fulfil** a promise without getting up.

The {Joker} cackles in the {Basement} of the {Hangar}, squirting *water drops* from his flower until the puddle **rises** past his purple knees. He draws a *stretched bow* and fires a trick playing card at the ceiling, where it pops open a banner reading BANG. The flood keeps **rising**, lifting him up, still grinning, with planes bobbing round him like rubber ducks.

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps through the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} and his tongue snaps up a *pheasant* stuffed with *light*. He gulps, shudders, beams leaking from his nostrils, and lays one egg so **brilliant** that it blazes through its shell. Ships steer by it, moths form a queue, and the *pheasant* pokes out its head, **brilliant** and blinking, demanding sunglasses.

{Naruto} charges into the {Basement} of the {Youth Hostel} and finds a *clown* blocking the stairs. A dozen shadow clones pile in, each one a *helping hand*, and together they **twist** the clown like a balloon animal, nose honking. Then the clones get carried away and **twist** Naruto too, so he bounces off in an orange knot, yelling that he never gives up.

{Tarzan} swings on a vine {Inside} the {Mansion}, baffled by carpets, and rips up the parquet to find some honest *soil*. It heaps itself into a mound, a rough **altar**, and a fluffy *cloud* drifts down to sit on top and rumble. He gives the jungle yell, the apes troop in, and everyone kneels at the **altar** of the weather.

{Batman} glides down in {Front} of the {Fort} and pulls a rotary phone from his utility belt, growling for backup. A gauntlet gadget springs out as a *helping hand* and spins the **dial** so hard that a hidden *launch pad* ignites beneath him. Every number he **dials** fires another Batmobile into the sky, and he broods as they rain down.

{Walter White} adjusts his glasses in the {Bathroom} of the {Fort} and measures *water drops* of plant food from a beaker onto the muddy floor. A barefoot *dancer* twirls through the mixture, and wherever her toes splash the ground turns **fertile**: tomatoes erupt, pumpkins swell, a sunflower knocks off his black hat. He proudly records the most **fertile** soil ever made in a school experiment.

{Homer} snoozes in the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room} until a *meeting* of bored patients wakes him, demanding doughnuts. His dim scheme is to pull a strand of *silk thread* from his robe, dip it in jam and **draw** doughnuts on the wall, hoping they turn real. He licks the finest **drawing**, gets a mouthful of plaster and howls, D'oh!

{Frodo} plods barefoot {Inside} the {Spa} after a very long walk, wanting only a nap under a potted palm. A *lumberjack* in a bathrobe bellows TIMBER and sets out to **cut down** the palm, the bamboo screens and the coat stand. Frodo slips on the Ring and hides, weary and invisible, while every towel rail around him is **cut down** too.

{Kermit} flails his arms in {Front} of the {Mansion}, stage-managing a garden show, when a stagehand passes him an *overflowing bowl* of hot soup. It slops over his banjo while *soil* from the collapsing scenery piles up to his webbed knees. Yaaay, he shrieks, because a frog must **endure** it: it's not easy being green, and he will **endure** anything until the curtain drops.

{Pikachu} bursts out of his Poké Ball {Inside} the {Pool} and finds a *standing person* in a bow tie holding a *fortune stick* like a tray. The stick wiggles and declares this man his **servant**. Pika, says Pikachu, testing him with one small spark, and the **servant** bows, hair frizzing, and carries him round the pool on the stick.

{Gandalf} arrives in {Front} of the {Warehouse} exactly when he means to and raps his staff on the ground. A *city wall* erupts from the cobbles, with fireworks spelling the name **Guo** along every battlement. A passing pigeon objects, so he thunders 'You shall not pass!' until it signs in as Mr **Guo**, and the wall swings politely open.

{Shrek} stomps out in {Front} of the {Beach} hut, wanting only to be left alone, but a storm god demands a **sacrifice** or there will be no more peace and quiet. Grumbling, he pushes forward his beloved *cow*, and a *bird nest* flies down to crown her. Donkey will not stop talking about what a noble **sacrifice** it is, so the god flees.

{James Bond} straightens his tuxedo in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} as a *skeleton* leads a *thousand ants* off with the coins. He clicks Q's cufflink, which does one thing: it releases an enormous anteater that will **annihilate** the whole column in a single slurp, and the skeleton collapses in shock. Total **annihilation**, he remarks, unruffled, and not one coin stirred.

{Mario} pops out of a warp pipe in the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} under a red *sunset* painted on the tiles, and stomps a heap of *soil*. Up rises a stone **tomb** with a question block floating over it. He head-butts the block, grabs the coin with a Wahoo, then reads his own name on the **tomb** and stomps it flat in protest.

{Gandalf} strides into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} needing a guard for his quest, and taps a *door* with his staff until it yawns open. A *sparrow* hops out with a tiny CV, and he reads it by staff-light, cranky and wise, then **hires** it with a puff of fireworks. By noon the door has coughed up forty more, and he must **hire** them all.

{Lara Croft} cartwheels {Inside} the {Yen Exchange} past swinging blades and finds an ancient *shed* guarding the relic: *two sheaves* of golden wheat on a pressure plate. Steal them and the boulders roll, because this puzzle wants someone **honest**. She drops one coin, the fair price, the sheaves bow and the shed creaks open, trap beaten by being **honest**, and she is rather disappointed.

{Chewbacca} ducks into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} hut, where a *big man* stands with a pocketknife over a *carving* in a surfboard: a **contract** promising him one spaceship. Chewbacca roars at the small print and rips the board in two in a temper. Then, being loyal, he welds the **contract** back together with ship parts and signs it with a growl.

{Pikachu} sits in {Front} of the {Inn} beside his Poké Ball, smashed into a hundred bits. A trainer's *helping hand* lays down *linked rails*, and his Thunderbolt powers a toy train that hauls each scrap along. Spark by spark he welds and **pieces together** the ball, and the moment it is **pieced together** it snaps open and catches him.

{Charlie Brown} sighs {Inside} the {Jungle} after a tree eats his kite, so he reports it and the ants vow to **punish** someone. A drumming *march* of soldier ants parades up behind a cracked paper *heart* that thumps out the beat. With his luck they **punish** him instead of the tree, and he must stamp along all day, muttering good grief.

The {Joker} cackles in {Front} of the {Warehouse} and aims a rubber *helping hand* on a spring at a passing guard. It shoots out, **grabs** his own *foot* and whips him upside down, green hair swinging. Laughing even harder, he squirts his flower and flicks a trick card that sprouts a second hand, which tries to **grab** the first.

{Frodo} limps into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} and feels a great Eye searching the water for the Ring. Bare feet slapping, he hauls a huge *cabinet* *back and forth* until its doors swing wide and **cover** the surface like a lid. Sam adds every towel, the Eye sees only planks, and the two hobbits sit on the **covered** pool eating lunch.

{Sherlock} crouches in {Front} of the {Water Park}, where a *standing knife* quivers upright in a slide, the only clue. He **brushes** it with a *dustcloth*, stroke by stroke, until a fingerprint appears, and smugly declares the culprit had a wet moustache. Elementary, he says, and he **brushes** Watson's moustache to prove it, which matches.

{James Bond} stands unruffled {Inside} the {Yeti Cave} as a burglar with one *strong arm* tries to **rob** the sleeping yeti of its fur and bolts for the *exit*. Q's bow tie does one thing: it spins the exit sign round to point at the yeti. The **robber** runs straight into a huge furry hug, and Bond murmurs that some exits are final.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Yen Exchange} and tries to pay a *woman* at the counter with *two sheaves* of swamp hay and an onion. She holds her nose: she **dislikes** hay, onions, ogres and talking donkeys. Shrek roars with delight, because he **dislikes** everybody too, and the pair sit in contented silence, flicking straw at Donkey.

{Gandalf} plants his staff in {Front} of the {Water Park} and mutters over one seed, and a giant *melon* bursts up and rolls at the crowd. You shall not pass, he bellows, and the **melon**, being polite, stops dead and explodes in fireworks. Now everyone floats on slices of **melon**, and he lights his pipe as though he planned it.

{Shrek} flops in {Front} of the {Yeti Cave} wanting only to **rest**, while Donkey's chatter hangs in the air as one huge *question mark* that bends over him like a deckchair. His *yawn* roars off the ice and blows Donkey clean down the mountain. Silence at last, so he curls into the curve and **rests**, snoring louder than any avalanche.

{Darth Vader} looms in {Front} of the {Cat Café}, breathing loudly, and ignites his red lightsaber to **carve** a block of cheese. A *sparrow* pecks the *circuit* on his chest panel, and every peck jolts the blade. He **carves** a perfect cat by accident, lifts it with the Force, and booms that he is its father while it meows for milk.

{Mario} warps into the {Bathroom} of the {Funfair} and finds a locked *gate* with no blocks, no coins and nothing to stomp. He is **bored**. His *heart* ticks slowly, he jumps once and lands, and his Wahoo comes out flat and **bored**, while even his moustache droops.

{Robocop} clanks through the {Basement} of the {Pool}, where a fluffy *hatchling* zooms about on a tiny *ski*, crying with hunger. His visor flashes a directive, feed all minors, and a hatch in his steel chest pours out a jet of warm **milk**. He politely arrests the chick for speeding, then releases it to ski away through puddles of **milk**.

{Charlie Brown} tries to fly his kite in the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond}, and of course it goes wrong. The line whips round and **strings together** a lily pad, a rubber boot, a frog in a hat and one furious swan into a long *kebab* that drags him across the water. Good grief, he says, as Snoopy **strings together** two sausages on the end.

{Walter White} sets out his beakers {Inside} the {Spa} to test what a *jade tablet* does in warm mud. A *woman* in a face mask drops it in by mistake, and the reaction fizzes, foams and becomes a gurgling **baby** in a fluffy towel. He checks his notes, proud and appalled, as the **baby** seizes his goatee and refuses to let go.

{James Bond} arrives in the {Basement} of the {Cat Café}, tuxedo spotless, to **hand in** his gadgets to a fat tabby clerk. He reels them out of his cuff on *silk thread*, but Q's last pen does one thing: it sprays *sparkle*. The tabby sneezes glitter across his lapels, and Bond, **handing in** the pen, says only that he preferred it shaken.

{Homer} wakes starving in the {Bathroom} of the {Swan Pond} and opens his enormous *mouth* to **call** for doughnuts. Swans glide in instead for a free *makeover*, part of his dim scheme to get them to fetch food: wigs, lipstick, feather boas. Each time he **calls**, another swan arrives, glamorous and empty-handed, and he groans, D'oh!

{Yoshi} flutter-jumps {Inside} the {Boxing Ring} and his sticky tongue whips past the champion's gloves to gulp down the *winner's purse*. Nobody can **win** now, so the crowd howls. He squats, strains and lays it back as an egg with a golden *shell*, which bounces off the champion's nose and flattens him, and Yoshi **wins** without throwing a punch.

{Lara Croft} climbs a pillar {Inside} the {Yen Exchange}, hunting a lost relic, while a *convoy* of tiny trucks rumbles over an ancient pressure plate. It tips pond *grass* into a stone basin, and a pink **lotus** pops open in the middle. She snatches the **lotus**, a boulder starts to roll, and she sprints off, ponytail flying, past startled customers.

{Batman} glides into the {Bathroom} of the {Spa}, where a bad-tempered **tyrant** commands indoor *rain* to soak anyone who dares relax. Gruff and unamused, he fires his grappling hook and lands in a *saddle* strapped to the **tyrant**'s back. He pops an umbrella from his utility belt and rides the brute round the tiles until the clouds give up.

{Tarzan} swings {Inside} the {Tower} on a vine tied to a *tree* growing up through the stairs and lets out his jungle yell. The noise shakes down a *cracked shell*, which splits on his head and out rolls a juicy **peach**. Baffled by the butler's fork, he hands it to an ape to demonstrate, then swings off with a **peach** in each foot.

{Tarzan} swings into the {Basement} of the {Warehouse} and, baffled by shelves, tries to sleep in a cardboard box, which is not **suitable** at all. A *soothing hand*, huge and hairy, pats his head as his ape mother drags the crates into a proper nest. He flops down, sighing, because at last civilisation has made something **suitable**.

{Sherlock} strolls into the {Bathroom} of the {Boathouse} and studies a creaking *sickbed* through his magnifying glass. From one crumb he deduces that the *elder* is so **thin** he has slipped through the slats, and indeed the old man floats out from under it like a kite. Elementary, he tells Watson, tying the **thin** fellow to his violin bow.

{Darth Vader} breathes heavily in {Front} of the {Spa}, disapproving of the sun. He raises one black glove, a *helping hand* of pure Force, and lifts bundles of *thatch* into the air to **put up** a hut without touching a thing. A crooked bundle gets Force-choked until it behaves, the hut is **put up** in seconds, and he booms that it will do.

{Frodo} sinks into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool} to rest his hairy feet when a *runner* skids in, waving a *fortune stick* that points east. You must **go to** the far end at once, the man gasps, as the stick pokes him in the ribs. Frodo groans, Sam packs sandwiches, and they **go to** the deep end on foot, a weary journey of three weeks.

{Yoshi} skids into the {Bathroom} of the {Ice Rink}, and his tongue slurps up a *hillock* and then a whole *mountain*, belly wobbling. He lays one gigantic egg that cracks open and stacks them, the hillock at the base and the peak on top, into one **high mountain** poking the clouds. He flutter-jumps up the **high mountain** and falls just short of the summit.

{James Bond} strolls in {Front} of the {Piazza} in his tuxedo while a stern *scholar* with a red pen marks his entrance. Q's fountain pen does one thing: whatever it writes on becomes **excellent**. Bond hands it over with a small bow, and the scholar writes on a pigeon, a fountain and his own forehead until the whole square is declared **excellent**.

{Cookie Monster} bounds up in {Front} of the {Hangar} and finds a *boat* on a trailer, with a little *barn* creaking open on its deck as a snug **cabin** stacked with biscuits. Me want cookie, he howls, googly eyes spinning. He devours the biscuits, the bunks and the door in a spray of crumbs until the whole **cabin** has gone.

{James Bond} steps into the {Bathroom} of the {Dunes}, adjusts his bow tie and squirts Q's aftershave, which does one absurd thing. Every *standing person* in the sand turns into a *handsome man* with his exact haircut, all admiring themselves in the mirrors. Bond surveys them, unruffled, and remarks that they are nearly as **handsome** as he is, sand in their teeth, **handsome** anyway.

The {Joker} tiptoes into the {Basement} of the {Beehive}, grinning, and piles *soil* round a red *stop sign*, declaring this the official **site** of his joke shop. The bees obey the sign and halt in mid-air. So he flips it to read GO, and they chase him, cackling, round and round his own building **site**.

{Pikachu} scampers {Inside} the {Hangar} and finds a *dragon* crammed into a garden *shed*, so **huge** that its tail pokes out of the window and the walls bulge. Pika, he says, and fires a Thunderbolt, which merely tickles. The beast sneezes, and the tiny yellow mouse sails across the hangar, amazed at how **huge** one sneeze can be.

{Gandalf} taps his staff in {Front} of the {Jungle} and an enchanted *plough* leaps up and drags itself round an old stone *well*, which spits sparks to keep it moving. It **ploughs** a perfect circle while parrots drop seeds behind it. You shall not pass, he shouts at one stubborn root, and the blade **ploughs** on while he puffs his pipe.

{Robocop} clanks into the {Bathroom} of the {Waiting Room}, where a *money changer* is filing *gold coins* on a whetstone until each one is razor **sharp**. His targeting display flashes a directive against dangerous objects as a coin whistles past and slices off his antenna. He stiffly reads every coin its rights and arrests them one by one, handcuffs shredded because they are too **sharp**.

{Frodo} trudges into the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle} on his very long walk, and a *chance meeting* stops him cold: a gorilla with split trousers, begging for help. The Ring tempts him to vanish and escape. Instead he pulls out *silk thread* and stitches the **seam** with tiny hobbit stitches, and the gorilla checks the **seam**, nods and carries him onward.

{Homer} wakes in the {Basement} of the {Waiting Room} and remembers he promised a *busy mother* to mind her five toddlers, then napped and ate their doughnuts. She glares, a child under each arm, and his *standing heart* wilts and slaps him across the chops. D'oh, he sobs, he **regrets** the nap, and he **regrets** nothing about the doughnuts.

{Yoshi} swallows a sack of cards in {Front} of the {Tower} and lays them as eggs all along a winding *road*, which carries them off down the hill. Each egg cracks in a burst of *sparkle* that spells out, you are **invited**. His tongue plucks pigeons and passing balloons to **invite** them personally, and he flutter-jumps at the moon, which arrives late.

{Lara Croft} flips over the ropes {Inside} the {Boxing Ring}, drawn by an ancient bell trap. A tiny stone *king* swings his bell, **ting-a-ling**, and a *herald* in tights shouts for the next boulder to drop. She cartwheels clear every time until she scales the corner post and gags the bell with her ponytail, one last muffled **ting-a-ling** and silence.

{Walter White} titrates a beaker {Inside} the {Lake} house while a *standing heart* thumps upright in a glass jar on his bench. A *sparrow* lands on the rim and sings, and his needle leaps: of thousands of birds tested, this is the **only** one that makes the heart race. He underlines it twice, proud of his science, and calls it the **only** result he trusts.

{Charlie Brown} slumps into the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} clutching a *chipped axe*, asking who broke it. The bees **blame** him, the queen agrees, and even Snoopy points a paw. Then the blade flies off and lands on his shoe, and he sighs good grief, because everyone always **blames** him, and this time they may be right.

The {Joker} cackles {Inside} the {Island} lighthouse, knocking on a tiny *dwelling* tucked under each step, where crabs, turtles and a grumpy seagull live. He hammers up signs reading Private **Residence**, then swaps all their door keys as a prank. A trick card springs from every letterbox announcing each tiny **residence** as his own, and a jet from his flower answers the seagull's complaint.

{Tarzan} swings down in {Front} of the {Yen Exchange} and meets a teapot, an object that baffles him completely. A *blushing* clerk begs for tea, so he calls an elephant, which sprays *water drops* in, and waves for it to **add** more. It keeps **adding** until the pot bursts, coins float away and the blushing clerk bobs past, redder than ever.

{Walter White} raps on the paving in {Front} of the {Spa}, the one who knocks, and hears a hollow sound. He pours a precise fizzing solution from a beaker, a gloved *helping hand* rises from his lab kit gripping a *shovel*, and it starts to **dig**. It **digs** through the sauna and the hot tub until steam shoots up and the great discovery proves to be a rubber duck.

{Homer} dozes in {Front} of the {Hut}, freezing, a doughnut stuck to his lip with frost, and his dim plan is to **breathe out** on it. He opens his *mouth*, and each time he **breathes out**, a warm cloud of icing fog rolls over the snow while his *nodding head* bobs along. The doughnut thaws, drops into a drift, and he moans, D'oh!

{Sailor Moon} whirls through her long sparkly transformation in the {Bathroom} of the {Lagoon}, and the splash drenches a *town square* full of fish in wigs, who file a **lawsuit**. A *small speech bubble* floats from her lips carrying a speech about justice, and Luna sighs. The crab judge bangs her claw, she cries so loudly that the tide comes in, and the **lawsuit** washes away.

{Yoshi} holds his breath too long in the {Basement} of the {Hangar} and turns from green to blue. His tongue snatches a *sheep* puffing *steam* from its nose, gulp, and he lays an egg that hisses at every crack with pure **oxygen**. He gulps it down, flutter-jumps up on the **oxygen** like a balloon, and the sheep staggers out of the shell, baaing.

{Homer} leaves the tap running in the {Bathroom} of the {Tower} and naps, and the *water drops* spread and spread until they form a **vast** ocean. An *announcer* on a passing buoy roars through a megaphone that this is the most **vast** sea ever. Homer wakes floating on a giant doughnut, looks for the shore, takes a bite and starts to sink.

{Yoshi} flicks out his tongue in the {Basement} of the {Museum} and swallows a stuffed goose from its display, and *feathers* blast from his nostrils like snow. He strains and lays an egg, and when it cracks there sits one lonely **feather**. He balances the **feather** on his snout, sneezes, and flutter-jumps after it through the dinosaur bones.

{James Bond} arrives in {Front} of the {Inn}, where a market woman demands to know whether her sack of rice is a full **catty**. Q's wristwatch unfolds into a tiny *axe* that does one thing: it chops anything into exactly half a kilo. Each bundle drops onto the scales as one perfect **catty**, and he straightens his cuffs and orders his rice shaken.

{Kermit} hops into the {Bathroom} of the {Pool}, stage-managing a talent show in sunglasses and trying to look **cool**. An *announcer* bawls his name and a *wine jug* full of ice cubes shoots under his feet, so he skids off with arms flailing, banjo flying and a panicked Yaaay. He crashes in a heap, and the crowd roars that this is really **cool**.

{Lara Croft} rappels into the {Bathroom} of the {Ice Rink} and finds a buried *palace* of ice, perfect for a proper tomb raid. She vaults a spike trap, but a greedy *helping hand* beats her to it, sliding from the wall to **plunder** crowns, candlesticks and golden skates. Appalled that anyone would **plunder** her tomb first, she chases it up a frozen column.

{Yoshi} waddles in {Front} of the {Tower} as a *woman* on a broomstick reveals herself as a **witch** and zaps a *dancer* into a spinning bat. Out shoots his tongue, and in one gulp the bat is gone, and he lays a speckled egg. The dancer hops out, restored, and the furious **witch** flies off after a dinosaur who has eaten her best spell.

{Homer} shuffles into the {Bathroom} of the {Warehouse} and spots doughnuts on a *small altar* beside a sizzling *wok*. His dim plan is to fry them, so he tips the pan, the oil spreads, and boxes of fireworks start going off, a total **disaster**. He hides under the wok with one doughnut, murmuring mmm, and wonders how a snack became such a **disaster**.

{Sherlock} peers through his magnifying glass in the {Bathroom} of the {Beehive} at a tiny wax *temple* and a *standing person* balancing a tray of honey cakes. From one crumb he deduces that the man must **serve** the queen bee, left-handed, since Tuesday. Elementary, he says smugly, and he makes Watson **serve** too, pouring nectar while he plays the violin.

{Yoshi} sets up a race in the {Basement} of the {Beach} hut, swallowing a crab and a *swan* and laying them back as two eggs. The crab's egg rolls out first and the swan's comes **second in order**. The bird hatches furious, curls itself into the shape of a 2 and sulks, and he pins on a silver medal, **second in order** for ever.

{Frodo} plods {Inside} the {Hangar} on his long walk, and a *woman* slides a giant concrete *square* across his path. Whenever he steps left the slab goes left too, to **hinder** him, so he wearily puts on the Ring and turns invisible. She simply follows the hairy footprints in the dust, and he is **hindered** all over again.

{Tarzan} swings down in {Front} of the {Mansion}, baffled by a *clock* that drops a golden *shell* at every tick. His apes have told him gold is useless, but he grabs them all, **greedy** as a monkey at a banana stall, stuffing his loincloth until it sags. The vine snaps under the weight, and the apes hoot at the most **greedy** man in the jungle.

The {Joker} dances into the {Bathroom} of the {Jungle} and challenges a gorilla to a *tug of war*, betting bananas. A rubber *helping hand* hidden behind him hauls the rope, and the gorilla lands in a heap, cackled at from all sides. He **earns** a whole bunch, squirts his flower in celebration, and every prank after that **earns** him more fruit.

{Walter White} lights a burner in {Front} of the {Hangar} to show how hydrogen and oxygen make *water drops*, and the lesson gets out of hand. They pour out until the tarmac is one glittering **expanse of water**. A tiny *king* in a rubber ring floats by demanding an end to the lecture, but Walter, proud of the exact ratio, rows on across the **expanse of water**.

{Naruto} bursts into the {Bathroom} of the {Cat Café} and spots a *lying man* asleep on a cushion, with a tomcat lifting its leg above him. Down trickles *water*, or rather **urine**, and Naruto summons a dozen shadow clones to dive in the way. Each clone gets hit and vanishes in a puff of smoke, but he never gives up, so he goes on making clones to stop the **urine**.

{Lara Croft} dives through a hidden hatch into the {Bathroom} of the {Beach} hut and lands in a chamber of tall *grass* around a golden *sickle*, the relic she came for. She lifts it, the trap wakes, and every swing she makes bursts white **jasmine** from the stalks. The perfume sends the stone guardians to sleep, and she somersaults out wearing a crown of **jasmine**.

{Shrek} stomps {Inside} the {Mint}, desperate for peace, and climbs a *stepladder* to **hang** Donkey by his collar on a line among the drying coins. Donkey only talks louder from up there. Then the ladder folds up with a snap, and now Shrek **hangs** right beside him by his braces, swinging, listening, with nowhere to go.

{Charlie Brown} sits gloomily {Inside} the {Casino}, amazed to have won a free *clam* at last. He lifts it to his *mouth* and of course it snaps shut on his **lip**.
